about: Assets for tools/assets/gemini.mjs. References are repository paths; a transparent reference is first put on the key colour with keyout.py flatten (into staging/ref_*.png). Run one id at a time with --only. flattenScale records the scale its reference was flattened at (keyout.py flatten ... #00ff00 <scale>).
style: Painted fantasy game art, rich hand-painted textures, warm rim light, Slavic folklore setting, crisp clean edges, no text, no watermark, no border.
keyLine: Background: one perfectly flat solid {key} colour filling the whole image, no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no glow spilling onto the background.

A rolled parchment scroll tied with a cord and sealed with a large blue wax seal stamped with an open eye. Simple bold silhouette, readable at small size. Isolated object, nothing behind it. Centred, the whole object in frame with a wide margin, three-quarter view.

A thick worn bronze token coin. On its face, carved in the flat style of Slavic folk wood-carving: Zmey Gorynych, a squat serpent-dragon standing on four legs, three small heads on long necks, simple patterned body, ornamental border of zigzags. Not a heraldic emblem, not a rearing pose, no wings spread. Chipped edges. Simple bold silhouette, readable at small size. Centred, the whole object in frame with a wide margin, three-quarter view.

An old iron key on a short leather tag. On the tag, a clear simple branded icon of a blacksmith hammer lying above an anvil, large and easy to read. Simple bold silhouette, readable at small size. Centred, the whole object in frame with a wide margin, three-quarter view.
